verdict.rationale: The axis applies: LibreOffice exposes an API (UNO, headless mode for external clients, and an SDK with API docs). However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI or an equivalent IDL artifact. Mentions of human-readable API docs and the CLI are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
